# 02-feature — add a capability

One run is one capability asked for in an issue: an event action given a runtime class, a network condition, a firmware, a CLI option, a scenario field, a shipped scenario. Spec first, then the code with its tests, then the proof and the records.

Stages, in order; inputs, outputs and checks for each are in [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md):

1. [Spec](stages/01_spec/CONTEXT.md) — what the issue asks, how a scenario will say it, how a run will prove it.
2. [Implement](stages/02_implement/CONTEXT.md) — the code and its tests, in the image.
3. [Verify](stages/03_verify/CONTEXT.md) — what CI will run, the documents, the pull request.
